title: Callvale before: RDS with one slow read replica
claim: The services write to an RDS primary with a standby, and dashboards read from one read replica that falls behind at peak.
alt: Before: the Fargate services send writes to the RDS for PostgreSQL primary in AZ 1, which keeps a standby in AZ 2. Dashboard queries go to one read replica in AZ 3, which falls behind at peak.

edges.label: writes
edges.say: The Fargate services send writes and most queries to the RDS primary.

edges.label: sync copy
edges.say: The primary keeps a standby in a second Availability Zone.

edges.label: dashboards
edges.say: Dashboard queries go to the one read replica.

edges.label: behind
edges.say: At peak, the read replica falls behind, and dashboards show old data.

notes: Brief 27 story pair, before (2-deep.md#decision-record, after Context). Same cells as aurora-after: services row 1, the writing instance in row 2, standby left and read replica right in row 3. Two columns (a third column is wider than a phone). Zones are named in labels (three zone boxes exceed the arch limits). Steps are story, not AWS rules: no fact link, no number, no absolute word. Keep say and Markdown steps equal (L703).
